hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has fled Brazil for the United States via Argentina and Ecuador following his presidential election defeat to Lula da Silva. The flight comes despite a Brazilian Supreme Court exit ban and pending investigations, sparking intense international coverage as the U.S. State Department confirmed visa issuance.
hotspots.affect: The spectacle of a high-profile far-right figure fleeing judicial accountability to Florida generates acute outrage among opponents and defensive maneuvering from allies.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Legal battles intensify around Marine Le Pen's 2027 presidential candidacy after high-ranking magistrate Didier Guérin affirmed she remains ineligible pending her appeal. Le Pen's legal team filed a formal complaint with the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature, claiming political bias while the Rassemblement National builds campaign momentum following its party congress.
hotspots.affect: High affective investment stems from perceived judicial interference in democratic elections and existential framing around Le Pen's eligibility.

hotspots.title: PP and Vox Pact to Control Spanish Senate
hotspots.blurb: Vox and the Partido Popular have finalized joint candidate lists and strategic agreements for the Senate to secure a conservative majority ahead of upcoming elections. Meanwhile, Vox leader Santiago Abascal has aggressively politicized the fatal Toledo train derailment, labeling it 'assassination on the tracks' caused by government corruption and refusing to halt campaign activities.
hotspots.affect: Outrage-driven rhetoric around national infrastructure failure combines with tense partisan maneuvering to maximize political confrontation.

hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rallies & Campaign Trail Violence
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump is accelerating campaign stops across swing and conservative states, including Texas, Mississippi, and Kansas, to rally the MAGA base ahead of the midterm elections. Coverage highlights fiery rally speeches, ongoing legal battles over election administration, and sharp partisan friction as Democrats push back on administration maneuvers.
hotspots.affect: High emotional charge driven by apocalyptic midterm messaging, voter fraud allegations, and intense base mobilization framing.

hotspots.title: SD-bråket avgör högerns framtid
hotspots.blurb: A public ideological feud between top Sverigedemokraterna figures Mattias Karlsson and Richard Jomshof over the definition of Swedishness has exposed sharp internal fractures. The dispute pitting biological nationalism against open cultural community has ignited widespread debate about the party's ideological direction and its impact on the Swedish right.
hotspots.affect: Intense ideological gatekeeping and intra-party confrontation generate high drama over national identity and political credibility.
